programmes.d: Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. However, Bella is kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island. Lewis tries to keep Will away from the island so the girls can rescue her.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programmes.d: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium and all the girls have to rescue Cleo's fish Hector.
Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Just a Girl at Heart
programmes.d: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt. Rikki and Cleo have to improvise when the cafe's first corporate function is actually a children's party.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Crime and Punishment
programmes.d: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the café and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will, so they can rescue Rikki together.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: To Have and to Hold Back
programmes.d: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.
An undefeated Blader named Zyro Kurogane travels to a big city, where he loses his first battle to a famous Blader by the name of Shinobu Hiryuin.
Zyro tires of training and challenges Eight to bey battle in the Cyclone Beystadium.
Benkei sponsors a one-day bey tournament, where Zyro defeats Shinobu in the final to avenge his earlier loss.
Zyro battles Kite and defeats him, but in a rematch, Kite claims victory to even the score.
In a rematch, Zyro uses Synchrome to combine his bey Ifrit with Shinobu's bey Salamander to defeat the Unabara brothers' bey Orochi Leviathan.
Benkei continues to train Bladers, with Kite, Eight, and Ren joining Shinobu, and Zyro.
Sabrina is shocked when Salem shows up at the witches’ academy one day and tries to hide him from the faculty.

Sabrina’s tired of sharing Harvey with all of his extra activities: sports practice, science club, after-school job at the local market, etc. But when she casts a spell making her Harvey’s top priority, she gets more than she planned on.

Sabrina knows there’s a big assignment due at school - a term paper on a world conqueror. (She chose Attila the Hun, thinking he’d been given a raw deal by history; she’s going to tell the true story.
Sabrina finds a forbidden spell book on Mr. Snipe’s desk and casts a spell to make him fall in love with the first person he sees.
Hilda & Zelda have been warning Sabrina about using magic she’s not ready to use.
Archie buys a pair of mystical fuzzy dice for his beloved car, Betsy, and unwittingly brings her to life when he hangs the dice on her rearview mirror.
Veronica treats Jughead like an outsider and excludes him from her guest list for a pool party she's throwing, on the basis that he's different.
In an effort to catch both Veronica and Betty's attention, Reggie attempts to steal some of Dilton's physique enhancing solution.
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Something very strange pops up when Simon, Dash, and Marshall try to crack the inner sanctum of Eerie's odd and exclusive lodge.
Rene Auberjonois plays the Donald, a PR wiz who puts Eerie into a shopping spree at World O' Stuff.
Seventeen year old Nathan is a star athlete who would do anything to play pro basketball.
Convinced that his Aunt Melva is too old and helpless to live on her own, a young city boy named Dale drives out to the "sticks" to retrieve her.
The ghost of a salty old captain has been regaling Gus with tales of traveling the seas. Consequently, Gus hasn't been studying for his mid-terms.
Verne arrives at his new boarding School in Hamburg for his first day and is horrified to discover that it is filled with all manner of magical beasts and beings!

Stiles recommends The Wolf Pack to entertain at the Wolverton Festival. However, this bike gang brings big trouble, and Scott must find a way to scare them out of town.

Scott and his family make a trip to Rottenberg, Transylvania in order to reconnect with their past. However, danger lurks when the townspeople seem very spooked by the castle that the family inherited.

Scott and his family volunteer on a farm for a week, but it proves to be a lot more work than they've expected. The animals sense that the Howards are werewolves and flee, leaving the Howards responsible for finding them before the farmer's return.

The town statue is stolen by a couple of crooks who ask for ransom money. The Howards learn that the inside of the statue contains the diary of their distant werewolf relative, and grow concerned that the diary could get into the wrong hands.
Archie is gung-ho to want to spread some Christmas cheer, annoying his more cynical friends.
It's Halloween horror time when Archie discovers vampires in Riverdale.

'Voodoo Man': When Voodoo Man's island is wiped out by a storm, he goes in search of the weatherman he believes is responsible. '7 Manly Men': When the toy in a box of cereal doesn't live up to its promise, the Manly Men confront the company owner.

'Driving Mr. Pink': Pinky calls a taxi to get to an urgent appointment, only to find that the taxi driver is the Voodoo Man. 'Ant & The Aardvark': The Aardvark just keeps trying to eat Ant, but a picnicking Rhino always seems to be in his way.

When Sonic saves a female hedgehog named Breezie, he falls in love. Sonic does not know that Breezie is a robot that Dr. Robotnik created to keep Sonic occupied while he floods a city near his fortress.
Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray. But when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.
The M.A.D. agents trying to destroy the circus are no match for Inspector Gadget, Penny and Chief Quimby.
Inspector Gadget prevents Dr. Claw from kidnapping the father of modern bionics, Professor Von Slicksfein.

Mr. Bean nearly gets fed to the fish! With his teddy bear at the dry cleaners, Mr. Bean finds himself feeling lonely. Fortunately, a new playmate appears in the shape of a goldfish from the garden pond.

A brand new lodger in the house could be a great new friend or could be your worst enemy. When Mr. Wicket gets a new lodger who is an Inventor, and a big nuisance, Bean discovers that he has to become ‘inventive’ himself.

Mr. Bean takes to the air after being taken for a ride. Conned by a mechanic into believing his beloved car to be beyond repair, Mr. Bean reluctantly consigns his faithful four-wheeled friend to the car crusher.
Mr. Bean makes a meal out of his Birthday celebration. Mr. Bean’s Birthday dinner gets off on the wrong foot when he and Teddy are made to take the worst table at a swanky restaurant.
Mr. Bean tries his hand as an international art sleuth. During a visit to London's National Gallery, Bean witnesses the theft of a major work of art.
Rip, Sam, and Cyril travel to China, to photograph “Llama's Skull”, an artifact said to protect all those “in his vision”.
When the Golden Helmet of Ur is stolen from the BION HQ, Rip, Cyril, and Sam follow its tracking device to Kuwait City, in the Middle East.
The Alliance learns that three powerful Vampire families are planning a merger...
Logan calls in an air strike on a Lycanthrope weapons dump before he realizes it is also a werewolf hospital...

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mermaid Magic
programmes.d: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Power Play
programmes.d: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the café. Cleo's caught in the crossfire with Kim when Samantha moves in and puts her stamp on the Sertori home.
